issues.title: One or more condition contrasts are not estimable
issues.message: The requested biological comparison cannot be separated from the other terms in the proposed design.
issues.recommendation: Redesign the experiment or remove only scientifically unjustified confounded terms; normalization cannot recover missing design information.

issues.title: The proposed design matrix is rank deficient
issues.message: At least one model coefficient is a linear combination of other coefficients.
issues.recommendation: Remove redundant terms or collect samples that cross the confounded factors.

issues.title: Condition and batch are nearly perfectly associated
issues.message: The biological effect may be difficult or impossible to separate from batch.
issues.recommendation: Confirm estimability in the proposed model; redesign the experiment if condition and batch are fully confounded.

issues.title: Cell-level metadata detected
issues.message: ReplicateGuard will evaluate inference at the sample level.
issues.recommendation: Use sample-level pseudobulk counts or a sample-aware mixed model downstream.
